_rule: Predicted relative change of the scene colour before post (5c3fdabc float mean) of each ON shot against its OFF neighbours, written and committed BEFORE the run (tools/m4_promotion_gate.py; a later commit is post hoc and does not pass). null: no change predicted.

shot-on.source: rt_water_rr_hitdist only changes RR's specular hit distance on water pixels (its history reprojection), not any radiance: at a static camera the mean is unchanged
shot-on.cost_source: one R16F store per water pixel in water_reflect (already traced); within the OFF spread
shot-on.flicker: rot-on burst: pan_artifacts final-luma temporal events below both rot-off bursts (lower is the fix working); the OFF-a vs OFF-b difference is the noise. No size derived: RR's response to the hit distance is not modelled offline
